create_lru_eviction_policy: create an LRU eviction policy instance to evict the least recently used LoRA adapter
create_fifo_eviction_policy: create a FIFO eviction policy instance for backward compatible LoRA adapter eviction
get_eviction_policy: get an eviction policy instance by name using the factory function for lru or fifo
mark_adapter_used: mark a LoRA adapter as used to update its access order in the eviction policy
select_eviction_victim: select a LoRA adapter victim for eviction from a set of candidate adapters
